bio.summary: Jacobs is a 2026 Boulder mayoral candidate. Yellow Scene reported that she emphasized fiscal sustainability, litigation and transparency at an August candidate forum.
bio.note: No BRL individual profile, Better Boulder answer, DBP PDF, or verified campaign website located by September 24, 2026; do not infer positions on other issues. The city campaign-finance list marks her website “To be developed”: https://webapps.bouldercolorado.gov/election/report.php?electionID=25&report=candidateList . The city candidate-video showcase includes her introduction, but a transcript was not available here: https://vimeo.com/showcase/12421306 .

statements.text: Her priorities consisted of fiscal sustainability, more effective litigators for the town, and transparency.
statements.speaker: Peter Constas (reporting the candidate)
